item.description: Location: Studio Two Three, 109 W 15th St, Richmond, VA 23224 | Cost: $20 | 3-hour figure drawing workshop with a professional nude model, poses called by artist Carter Helmandollar. item.description: Location: Studio School, 200 N Arthur Ashe Boulevard, Richmond, VA 23220 | Cost: $80 | Start by exploring a variety of drawings of the human form by other artists.
